description: This PHP source file defines a UserEntity class that implements the OAuth2 Server's UserEntityInterface. It provides functionality to represent a user with an identifier, create an instance from a User entity, and retrieve the identifier.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: A class implementing the OAuth2 Server's UserEntityInterface to represent a user by their identifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of UserEntity with a user identifier.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Creates a UserEntity instance from a User entity by extracting its ID.
